destinations.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace & Bukchon Hanok Village
destinations.nearest_station: Gyeongbokgung Station (Subway Line 3, Exit 5) or Anguk Station (Line 3, Exit 3)
destinations.autumn_highlight: The ginkgo trees along the stone palace walls turn vibrant golden yellow in early November. Royal Guard Changing Ceremony at 10:00 and 14:00 daily (closed Tuesdays).

destinations.name: Myeongdong Shopping Street & N Seoul Tower
destinations.autumn_highlight: Take the Namsan Suncheon Circular Green Bus #01 up to N Seoul Tower for 360-degree sunset views of Seoul's autumn foliage.

destinations.name: Hongdae Youth Culture & Gyeongui Line Forest Park
destinations.nearest_station: Hongik University Station (Subway Line 2, AREX, Gyeongui-Jungang Line)
destinations.est_transit_time_from_center: 15 min from Seoul Station via AREX All-Stop
destinations.autumn_highlight: Yeonnam-dong's Gyeongui Line Forest Park (Yeontral Park) is lined with orange maple trees and cozy autumn terrace cafes.

destinations.name: Gangnam District & COEX Starfield Library
destinations.nearest_station: Samseong Station (Subway Line 2) or Bongeunsa Station (Subway Line 9)
destinations.autumn_highlight: Across from COEX Mall is Bongeunsa Temple, a 1,200-year-old Buddhist sanctuary where red maples frame skyscrapers.

destinations.name: Seongsu-dong ('The Brooklyn of Seoul') & DDP
destinations.nearest_station: Seongsu Station (Subway Line 2) / Dongdaemun History & Culture Park Station (Line 2/4/5)
destinations.autumn_highlight: Industrial brick warehouses converted into flagship fashion pop-ups and artisan bakeries, surrounded by autumn street trees.

destinations.name: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress (UNESCO Day Trip)
destinations.nearest_station: Suwon Station (KORAIL ITX-Saemaeul / KTX / Subway Line 1)
destinations.est_transit_time_from_center: 30 min via ITX-Saemaeul Train from Seoul Station (or 60 min via Subway Line 1)
destinations.autumn_highlight: Walk the 5.7 km 18th-century stone fortress walls surrounded by red ginkgos and silver grass. Stunning archery pavilion views.

destinations.name: Nami Island & Gapyeong Autumn Foliage
destinations.transit_card_used: KORAIL ITX-Cheongchun Ticket (Book on KorailTalk app)
destinations.est_transit_time_from_center: 50 min from Yongsan Station or Cheongnyangni Station
destinations.autumn_highlight: Korea's most famous autumn destination! Walk the Ginkgo Tree Lane and Metasequoia Lane under a golden canopy.

destinations.name: DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) & Imjingak Peace Park
destinations.nearest_station: Imjingak Station (DMZ Peace Train / Verified Tourist Shuttle)
destinations.autumn_highlight: Visit the 3rd Infiltration Tunnel and Dora Observatory overlooking North Korea. Civilian access requires passport and booking.

destinations.name: Seoraksan National Park & Sokcho Coastal Village
destinations.transit_card_used: Express Bus Ticket (Book via KOBUS / T-money GO)
destinations.est_transit_time_from_center: 2 hr 20 min via Express Bus from Seoul Express Bus Terminal (Gangnam)
destinations.autumn_highlight: The premier granite mountain range of South Korea. Take the Seoraksan Cable Car up to Gwongeumseong Fortress for crimson foliage peaks.

destinations.name: Haeundae Beach & Blue Line Park Coastal Train
destinations.est_transit_time_from_center: 45 min from Busan KTX Station via Metro
destinations.autumn_highlight: Crisp ocean breezes, golden beach sunsets, and the retro Haeundae Beach Train running along coastal cliffs from Mipo to Songjeong.

destinations.name: Gamcheon Culture Village & Jagalchi Seafood Market
destinations.nearest_station: Toseong Station (Busan Metro Line 1, Exit 6) + Town Bus Saha 1-1 / 2-2
destinations.autumn_highlight: The 'Machu Picchu of Busan' features colorful terraced houses overlooking the ocean. Walk down to Jagalchi Market for fresh autumn seafood.

destinations.name: Haedong Yonggungsa Seaside Temple
destinations.nearest_station: Osiria Station (Dong해 Line) or Bus #181 / Kakao T Taxi from Haeundae
destinations.autumn_highlight: One of the only Buddhist temples in Korea built directly on ocean rocks, dramatic wave crashes under crisp November skies.

destinations.name: Gyeongju Historic Center (Option A - Top Recommended)
destinations.nearest_station: Singyeongju Station (KTX / SRT) -> Bus #700 into Historic Center
destinations.est_transit_time_from_center: 35 min KTX from Busan Station (or 2 hr 05 min KTX from Seoul Station)
destinations.autumn_highlight: Bulguksa Temple, Seokguram Grotto, and Daereungwon Tumuli Park offer the most magnificent crimson maple and golden ginkgo displays in South Korea.

destinations.name: Jeju Island (Option B - Volcanic Island)
destinations.transit_card_used: Domestic Flight + Tourist Taxi Charter / T-money
destinations.est_transit_time_from_center: 1 hr flight from Busan Gimhae (PUS) or Seoul Gimpo (GMP)
destinations.autumn_highlight: Silver grass waving across volcanic oreums and Hallasan National Park trails.

destinations.name: Jeonju Hanok Heritage Village (Option C - Food Capital)
destinations.nearest_station: Jeonju Station (KTX) -> 15 min Kakao T Taxi
destinations.est_transit_time_from_center: 1 hr 40 min KTX from Seoul Yongsan Station
destinations.autumn_highlight: Over 800 traditional wooden Hanok houses surrounded by ancient ginkgo trees at Jeonju Hyanggyo Confucian School.
